intro: Banks and shipping stores in Manhattan often stop taking notarizations in the late afternoon, which is why people looking after work or on a weekend come up empty. This page lists notaries that publicly advertise evening, weekend, or mobile service in New York City, with a Manhattan focus. Every hour, fee, and service flag comes from the business’s own website or a page it publishes, and is dated when we last checked it. If we could not verify a detail, we left it out. Call or text to confirm availability before you book — hours change, and many of these visits are by appointment.
